exposure: Acute kidney injury in pregnancy and postpartum
outcome: Incidence of AKI in pregnancy and postpartum
cohort: The study included women with AKI during the antepartum or postpartum period.
finding: The study found that hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and sepsis were the most common causes of AKI in pregnancy and postpartum, which was associated with significant maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 64.71% of the neonates
